extracted.intended_audience: readers of Nature (scientists, museum/academic job applicants, and institutional administrators in early-20th-century UK)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural, eligibility, and submission requirements for academic, municipal, and museum posts and for paid notices/advertisements as published in this issue of Nature (May 1907).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use official application form and meet stated deadline (London County Council lecturers)
rubrics_metrics.description: "An>l>cntions should be made on the official form, to be obtained, together with particulars of the appointment, from the Clerk of the London County Council, Education Offices, Victoria Embankment, W.C, to whom they must be returned not later than 10 a.m. on Saturday, June 8, 1907, accompanied by copies of three testimonials of recent date."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A separate form must be obtained and used for each post for which application is made. Candidates applying through the post for the form of application should enclose a stamped and addressed envelope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canvassing disqualifies applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: "Canvassing, either directly or indirectly, will be held to be a disqualification for employment."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This prohibition is stated for multiple municipal and council appointments (London County Council, Borough appointments, etc.) and is to be taken as grounds for disqualification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide copies of three recent testimonials with application
rubrics_metrics.description: "...accompanied by copies of three testimonials of recent date."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This requirement recurs across many advertised posts (London County Council posts, County of London Science Mistress, Borough appointments, etc.) and is an explicit documentation requirement for candidates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications must state age, experience and qualifications and be endorsed with post name (Curator)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Applications, stating the age, experience, and qualifications of the candidate, accompanied by copies of not less than three recent testimonials, and endorsed 'Curator', to be forwarded to the undersigned on or before the 28th instant."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The advert specifies how applications must be presented (content and endorsement). It also ties to a deadline and to other appointment conditions (salary, full-time requirement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Curator appointment conditions: whole-time service and tenure at pleasure of Council
rubrics_metrics.description: "the gentleman appointed, who will be required to devote his whole time to the duties, will hold office during the pleasure of the Council."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This states employment conditions (full-time commitment and that the appointment is held at the Council's pleasure) and is part of the evaluation/offer terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for Senior Mistress (Borough of Widnes)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Applicants must be graduates of a British University and possess good qualifications in German and one or both of the following subjects:— Mathematics, Domestic Science."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The advert also states salary scale, incremental increases, and that appointment is subject to the approval of the Lancashire Education Committee; duties to commence in September.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistant Mistress (Bromsgrove) competence and application content
rubrics_metrics.description: "WANTED immediately, an ASSISTANT MISTRESS competent to teach General Form Subjects and Art, and to take an active interest in games."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must state age, qualifications and actual teaching experience, together with copies of three recent testimonials; salary up to £100 per annum according to qualifications and experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertisement and notices insertion charges and format rules (Nature)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Announcements or Births, Marriages and Deaths are inserted in the advertisement pages of 'Nature' at ... for two lines of eighteen words. Each additional line of nine words costs 1s. All orders should be accompanied by remittance to cover cost."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separately, the advertisement charge table gives rates (e.g., 'Three Lines in Column - 0 2 8'), and: 'The first line being in heavy type is charged for as Two Lines.' These are the publisher's formatting and pricing rules for paid notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postal requests for application forms must include stamped addressed envelope
rubrics_metrics.description: "Candidates applying through the post for the form of application should enclose a stamped and addressed envelope."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a procedural requirement to obtain the official application form by post; repeated for several advertised posts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate application form required for each post applied for
rubrics_metrics.description: "A separate form must be obtained and used (for each post for which application is made)."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants cannot use one form to apply for multiple posts; each post requires its own official form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appointment subject to approval of an external committee
rubrics_metrics.description: "The appointment is subject to the approval of the Lancashire Education Committee."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some advertised posts (e.g., Borough of Widnes) are conditional on an external body's ratification; candidates should expect additional review/approval steps beyond employer selection.
